summary: Which stable (ehull ≤ 0.05 eV/atom), non-toxic (no Pb/Cd/Hg/Tl/As) materials achieve SLME ≥ 30%, and can we find 10 such hits with far fewer expensive SLME calculations than random screening requires?
evidence: Lab objective; SLME budget is the bottleneck; cheap proxies are composition, OptB88vdW band gap, and stability.

summary: Dataset contains 1,362 stable (ehull ≤ 0.05 eV/atom), non-toxic (no Pb/Cd/Hg/Tl/As) candidates; 129 are hits at SLME ≥ 30%, giving a 9.47% base rate. Random screening requires ~106 expensive calculations to find 10 hits.

Direct band-gap character and band-gap magnitude in the 1.0–1.6 eV range are the primary cheap descriptors for high SLME: halide double perovskites with band gaps >1.9 eV or dipole-forbidden (indirect) transitions fail to exceed ~3% PCE and are systematically eliminated by SLME screening, establishing gap type as a decisive filter before any expensive optical calculation.
evidence: DOI: 10.1021/jacs.1c06403 (Yu & Zunger group, JACS 2021); DOI: 10.48550/arxiv.2208.12736 (ML screening lead-free halide double perovskites, 2022)

summary: A high-throughput SLME screening workflow applied to a curated dataset of experimentally reported 2D hybrid organic-inorganic perovskites identified more than 25 compounds with promising photovoltaic potential, demonstrating that compositional + structural descriptors (spacer identity, layer number) can stratify a candidate pool before full optical calculations.
evidence: DOI: 10.48550/arxiv.2609.27616 (High-Throughput Photovoltaic Screening and Spacer-Dependent Shift Current in Two-Dimensional Hybrid Perovskites, 2026)

summary: JARVIS-DFT (OptB88vdW functional) provides ~40,000 3D materials with formation energies, convex-hull distances, and optical properties; the infrastructure explicitly supports SLME calculations as one of its standard high-throughput outputs, making it the canonical DFT database for this screening campaign.
evidence: DOI: 10.1038/s41524-020-00440-1 (JARVIS for data-driven materials design, Choudhary et al. 2020, 544 citations)

summary: Crystal-graph attention neural networks trained on a chemically balanced dataset achieve unprecedented generalization accuracy for predicting thermodynamic stability (ehull), enabling active-learning loops that query DFT only for the most uncertain or highest-utility candidates; the authors demonstrate ML-assisted mapping of the global zero-temperature phase diagram at reduced computational cost.
evidence: DOI: 10.1002/adma.202210788 (ML-Assisted Determination of the Global Zero-Temperature Phase Diagram of Materials, 2023, 109 citations)

summary: Parallel Bayesian optimization applied to energy–structure–function (ESF) maps selectively reduces expensive property simulations by querying only high-utility regions of compositional space; the approach is proposed as a next-generation alternative to exhaustive high-throughput screening when the expensive property (here SLME) constitutes the bottleneck.
evidence: DOI: 10.26434/chemrxiv.13019960.v1 (Distributed Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization for ESF Maps, 2020)

summary: Sn-based chalcogenide perovskites are identified as lead-free, non-toxic alternatives with exceptional stability, optimal band gaps for solar absorption, and strong light absorption; the family shows remarkable defect tolerance, making it a high-priority target for SLME screening in JARVIS-DFT.
evidence: DOI: 10.1039/d4tc04701j (Post-transition metal Sn-based chalcogenide perovskites, 2025, 18 citations)

summary: Half-Heusler compounds LiZnAs and ScAgC show direct G0W0 band gaps of 1.5 eV and 1.0 eV respectively, with imaginary dielectric function peaks reaching 88–91 (arb. units), indicating exceptionally strong optical absorption relevant to high SLME; both are Pb/Cd/Hg/Tl/As-free.
evidence: DOI: 10.1103/z3dg-jxt1 (Many-body ab initio study of LiZnAs and ScAgC for photovoltaics, 2025, 5 citations)

summary: Lead-free quaternary antiperovskites designed by ion-type inversion and anion ordering achieve high-performance photovoltaic properties; this structural engineering strategy circumvents the wide-gap and forbidden-transition problems endemic to halide double perovskites, establishing anion-ordered antiperovskites as a distinct non-toxic family worth prioritising in SLME screens.
evidence: DOI: 10.1021/jacs.1c06403 (Design of High-Performance Lead-Free Quaternary Antiperovskites, JACS 2021, 63 citations)
